mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.sender_id AS senderId, m.receiver_id AS receiverId, m.content, m.image_url AS imageUrl, m.is_read AS isRead, m.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(up.nickname, su.username) AS senderName, up.avatar AS senderAvatar FROM ( SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, image_url, is_read, create_time FROM message WHERE (sender_id = #{me} AND receiver_id = #{peer}) OR (sender_id = #{peer} AND receiver_id = #{me}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) m JOIN sys_user su ON m.sender_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON su.id = up.user_id AND up.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.id ASC

SELECT m.id, m.sender_id AS senderId, m.receiver_id AS receiverId, m.content, m.image_url AS imageUrl, m.is_read AS isRead, m.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(up.nickname, su.username) AS senderName, up.avatar AS senderAvatar FROM message m JOIN sys_user su ON m.sender_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON su.id = up.user_id AND up.deleted = 0 WHERE m.receiver_id = #{me} ORDER BY m.id DESC
